question: In a certain code, NEPAL is written as MVKZO and CHINA is written as XSRMZ. How will INDIA be written as in that code?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

NEPAL is written as MVKZO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92adfd150fea2bf9a29587be0e3ccc849efd015a22910514dc783640f2144ef8.png] 

And,

CHINA is written as XSRMZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/780e2eb1d05baaee16b4daddbb775826a4a08338d2b672f3f60dbef59d8f7dd0.png] 

Similarly,

INDIA is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a20eb5a2f23a825120195ef6eaf980dcf33c55f57522b4dd19bf041db9d2d48.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
